gloss: otherwise; unless it is; if not

definitions.gloss: unless it is ~; if it isn't ~
definitions.explanation: Attaches to a noun or na-adjective to give a condition that must be met, with the consequence of not meeting it following. The casual contraction of ではないと.
Used alone at the start of a sentence to warn what will happen if the action just mentioned is not taken. Conversational equivalent of さもないと.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧じゃないと⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: You can't go in unless you're an adult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土曜日|どようび}→土曜日：00621_doyoubi⟧じゃないと⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れません→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: I can't find time unless it's a Saturday.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経験者|けいけんしゃ}→経験者：18664_keikensha⟧じゃないと⟦{任|まか}せられない→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The manager says this job can only be entrusted to someone with experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}ごう→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧。じゃないと⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: Let's hurry. Otherwise we won't make it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧いきな⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。じゃないと⟦{濡|ぬ}れる→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Take an umbrella. Otherwise you'll get wet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日中|きょうじゅう}→今日中：19382_kyoujuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。じゃないと⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}たせる→待つ：00469_matsu⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: You'd better reply today. Otherwise you'll end up keeping them waiting.

notes:
The contraction of ⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧. Casual: fine in conversation and messages, but ⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ or でないと is expected in writing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun]じゃないと[⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧/⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧]: it has to be ~, or it can't be done
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧じゃないと⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧: it has to be now or we won't make it
- じゃないと〜ちゃう: casual warning of an unwanted result

SIMILAR WORDS:
- でないと: the same meaning in a more neutral register, usable in writing
- じゃ⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧: slightly more formal, and less pointed as a warning
- ⟦そうしないと→そうしないと：30682_soushinaito⟧: refers back to an action rather than attaching to a noun
